HediffDef.label: war-hardened
HediffDef.description: Something in them went quiet after the fighting. They now decide for themselves who is beyond saving. When someone nearby is downed and dying, they will put them out of their misery, whether anyone agrees or not.

MentalStateDef.label: mercy killing
MentalStateDef.beginLetter: {0} has decided that {1} is beyond saving ({2}).\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] is going to put them out of their misery. Save {1} first, for example by stopping the bleeding or treating the illness, and it will end.
MentalStateDef.recoveryMessage: {0} is no longer set on a mercy killing.

JobDef.reportString: putting TargetA out of their misery.
